# EasyWorkTools.online

> Free browser-based tools for everyday digital work. Text, image, PDF and
> developer utilities that mostly run in the visitor's browser, with a short and
> specific list of what does leave it.

EasyWorkTools.online is a static site of 242 free online tools and 129
how-to guides. Most tools run client-side: the text, images and files you use are
not uploaded, and there is no account or paywall. A small number of features do
contact a server - the Thumbnail Downloader sends the link you paste to this site
to fetch a public preview image, the homepage feedback form emails what you type
to us via Google Apps Script, and page-view paths are counted to order the lists.
See https://easyworktools.online/security for the exact details.

**Canonical origin:** https://easyworktools.online

## Index

- [Tools](#tools) - 242 utilities, listed by category
- [Guides](#guides) - 129 how-to guides
- [Legal and informational pages](#legal-and-informational-pages)
- [How the tools work](#how-the-tools-work)
- [Machine-readable data](#machine-readable-data)
- [Contact](#contact)

## Categories

Every tool is also reachable from a per-category page that lists the whole set:

- [AI Write](https://easyworktools.online/categories/ai-write/) - Write, rewrite, summarize, and generate articles, emails, and social copy with free AI writing tools that run right in your browser. (54 tools)
- [Image Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/image/) - Resize, convert, compress, edit and inspect images online. Everything runs in your browser, so your photos never leave your device. (46 tools)
- [PDF Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/pdf/) - Convert, merge, split, compress, reorder, and watermark PDF files free in your browser—no account, no uploads, and nothing to install. (37 tools)
- [Developer Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/developer/) - Format, encode, decode, validate and generate the things developers need constantly: JSON, Base64, JWT, regex, hashes and slugs. (19 tools)
- [SEO Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/seo/) - Check and improve page SEO with free generators for meta tags, schema markup, sitemaps and robots.txt, plus on-page analysis. (14 tools)
- [Text Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/text/) - Count, clean, reformat, compare and extract text with fast utilities for lists, line endings, letter case and word statistics. (12 tools)
- [Converter Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/converter/) - Convert between metric and imperial units—length, weight, temperature, area, volume, and data—with our fast, free online unit converter. (45 tools)
- [Calculator Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/calculator/) - Quick, accurate online calculators for exact age, percentages, discounts, and everyday date math—free and instant in your browser. (6 tools)
- [Video & Audio Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/video-audio/) - Compress, trim, and extract frames from videos or convert and edit audio files privately in your browser—no uploads required. (5 tools)
- [Utility Tools](https://easyworktools.online/categories/utility/) - Practical browser utilities for generating strong random passwords locally and converting HEX, RGB, and HSL colors for web design. (4 tools)

## How the tools work

Most tools run in the visitor's browser. There is no account and no file upload,
so for those tools:

- your text, images and documents are not sent to a server, and are not stored;
- the tools keep working offline once the page has loaded;
- there is no rate limit, because there is nothing to rate-limit.

The exceptions, stated plainly: the Thumbnail Downloader sends the link you paste
to this site's own server to fetch a public preview image from the platform; the
homepage feedback form sends the details you type, including an optional email
address, to a Google Apps Script endpoint that emails them to us; and the site
records page-view paths, with no account or personal details attached, to order
the tool and guide lists by popularity. The full, current list is at
https://easyworktools.online/security

The consequence worth stating plainly: the tools do the part that can be done
correctly and locally. Anything whose name suggests a hosted AI model - the
Humanizer, the Detector, the Rephraser, the Translate tool - is implemented from
published, checkable signals (sentence-length distribution, lexical variety,
contraction and hedge usage, punctuation habits, passive voice, filler phrases,
word-frequency analysis), and each such page states its real scope and limits on
the page itself. No tool claims a model, a ranking or an accuracy figure that
cannot be substantiated, and no tool claims to make content true or verified.

## Machine-readable data

- [ai-catalog.json](https://easyworktools.online/ai-catalog.json) - every tool
  and article with its URL, description, tags and structured data. Generated by
  the build from the manifests and the JSON-LD actually present on each page, so
  it cannot drift from the site.
- [sitemap.xml](https://easyworktools.online/sitemap.xml) - all indexable URLs.
- [tools-manifest.json](https://easyworktools.online/tools-manifest.json) - the
  tool index the build and the client-side search both read.

Structured data on the site: every tool page carries SoftwareApplication and
FAQPage; every article carries BlogPosting and FAQPage; the homepage carries
WebSite and Organization. Every FAQPage block is generated from the questions
and answers a reader can see on the page.

## Contact

info@easyworktools.online

Corrections, bug reports and tool requests are all welcome. If a tool gives a
wrong answer, say which tool, what you put in and what came out - that is the
fastest way to get it fixed.

## Usage

This file follows the llms.txt convention. You are welcome to read, quote and
follow the links in it. Please attribute anything you reuse to
EasyWorkTools.online and link back to the page it came from.
